scheme_name: Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Cycle, Chhatari, Chappal/Joota Sahayta Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered in any district of Chhattisgarh.
If the applicant has received any other parallel scheme of the State Government, they are not eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides a cycle, umbrella, and slipper/shoe assistance to eligible women.
